baselineRatingSource: Mean of 20 independent Source23 role reviews in BRIEF.md
reviewPerspective: Fan protected power distribution and native copper, with whole-board route inventory metrics; scoped verification does not claim duplicate full-board DRC/continuity acceptance.
overallAssessment: Source24d is a measurable improvement. The fan shortcut removes 8.670 mm while keeping the 0.8 mm power branch independent of the quiet ADC tap and preserving both all-through barrels. Total native routing decreases and less routing occupies inner1. Remaining long peripheral routes, narrow pour clearance margins, and the large via inventory keep the whole board below an exceptional score.
verifiedStrengths: All final fan/stub/ADC route segments pass independent native copper/drill clearance against regenerated BREP pours.
The separate 0.8 mm fan trunk starts at C28; the 0.2 mm ADC trace starts at R222 and intersects the fan centerline only at the explicit pickup.
Both power barrels retain 0.3 mm drill, 0.7 mm pad and top/inner1/inner2/bottom copper clearance.
The 45-degree fan corner keeps exact source endpoint ownership and creates no additional barrel.

residuals.fact: Fan feed remains 81.922136 mm for 36.988999 mm endpoint separation and an obstacle-free octilinear lower bound of 40.020160 mm.
residuals.assessment: The shortcut improves resistance/length by 9.57%, but the perimeter feed is still long. This is an economy penalty; no safer materially shorter complete route was established.

residuals.fact: Retained fan-bottom/GND-pour gap is 0.207062458 mm and quiet-ADC-bottom/GND-pour gap is 0.208507048 mm against 0.200 mm policy.
residuals.assessment: Both pass nominal native geometry, with small residual clearance margins. These values are explicitly reported rather than waived.

residuals.fact: The final board retains 289.686506 mm of native wire on inner1.
residuals.assessment: Reduced by 38.244 mm from Source23, but significant routing remains on the main reference-plane layer.

residuals.fact: Whole-board native inventory is 636 traces and 434 vias; baseline was 633 traces and 433 vias.
residuals.assessment: The final campaign reduces route length and ground-layer usage but does not reduce overall via count. Fan-specific via count is unchanged.

limits: Thermal/ampacity, manufactured tolerances, and bench operation are not proved by these CAD checks.
Whole-board continuity, complete foreign-net isolation and final manufacturing/Gerber checks belong to the root campaign validators.
